topics.label: Introduction and lecture objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and outlines the key learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Clonal selection and epigenetic drivers in pre-neoplastic tissue
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective advantages that drive clonal expansion in pre-neoplastic tissues.

topics.label: Cell of origin and the cancer stem cell model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the cancer stem cell model and the impact of the cell of origin on malignant transformation.

topics.label: The role of the microenvironment and inflammation in cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammatory signals and stromal interactions within the microenvironment promote tumor initiation, dedifferentiation, and growth.

topics.label: Techniques for analysing tumor evolution and spatial architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the experimental and computational technologies used to analyse tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated summary of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the lecture's core concepts into an integrated, multi-factorial framework of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Closing remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on therapy.
